requirements.accept: Populated v6->v7 preserves every previous row, ledger, issued graph and correction branch; repeat and failed migration execute atomically.

An issued EvidenceReference points to exactly one pinned issued EvidenceItem version and >=1 pinned issued recorded-artifact target versions. The item role is contextual in the selected reference graph, not a global or identity-supplying class.

Keep explicit support/challenge/context, statement and source JSON/locator/interpretation/time immutable and independently attributable to reference and item versions; payload and normalized pins agree.

Exact target-version queries preserve all explicit references, sources, historical item/target pins and equal-label distinct identities; native graphs match literal directions and infer no endorsement, occurrence or independent corroboration.
Actual atomic seal/rollback, schema/hash/FK/configuration and semantic audits, backup/reopen/dump/tamper controls retain every prior audit.
Account for all 306 native elements and six newly partial routes with original dispositions retained; original scientific receipts and all 11 WITHHELD organizational admissions remain unchanged.

policy.reference: C065 is a documentary subkind using existing InformationArtifact identity and a separate version-owned evidence snapshot.
policy.item: C066 is a contextual role on an existing issued InformationArtifact version. No global artifact_typing/knowledge_type membership or new bearer identity is created. It appears only in the selected reference-version graph.
policy.targets: R-68 requires >=1 explicit existing issued InformationArtifact versions. At most one pinned version per target artifact per reference is a bounded application policy; unknown identity remains raw, no fabricated target.
policy.item_cardinality: RX-021 has exactly one evidence-item version pin; target has at least this one reference in the selected graph. Multiple references to the same bearer are not independent corroboration.
policy.qualification: support/challenge/context are supplementary application values implementing selected C-12 interpretation. The native predicate supportsRecordedArtifact does not assert truth or endorsement, including when qualification is challenge/context.
policy.provenance: Reference source and evidence-item version source remain separate. Later version source may differ from artifact origin. Raw source_record is documentary provenance, not automatic EvidenceItem admission.
policy.versioning: All source/statement/role/pins are sealed with payload; native graph and target query selected by exact issued version, no historical union/latest/authority policy. General correction for evidence references is deferred.
policy.native_projection: C065, contextual C066, inherited C014, C015/RX-006, R-68 and RX-021 only. R-69..R-72 occurrence/agent/activity links are deferred; no occurrence/causation inferred.
policy.typing: Bounded storage selects a separate C065 representation on a generic C014 artifact, separate from assessment/knowledge typing. This storage restriction is not native disjointness.
policy.publication: Development component for PLANNED v0.3.4; stable v0.3.3, model 0.3.1, ORSD 0.4.3, DRSD 0.1.0 and article 7.0.8 unchanged.
